Browser mode 'never' prevents browser use even when JS render hint is set

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { BrowserMode, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: BrowserMode.Never } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.jsRenderHint);
  console.log(result.browserUsed);
}

void main();
```
